value: For the [Craving > Neutral; Schizophrenia > Controls] contrast, we found increased activations in schizophrenia, relative to Control smokers, in the right and left vmPFC.
Between-group differences in activations remained significant after controlling for differences in depressive symptoms.
No increased activations were found in Control relative to SCZ smokers.
These results suggest that the neurophysiologic mechanisms involved in the regulation of cigarette cravings are impaired in schizophrenia.
